preconditions.description: The number of destinations n is between 2 and 10^5 inclusive.
The number of Time Corridors m is between n-1 and 10^6 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b, e in corridors)
preconditions.description: Each Corridor connects two distinct destinations a and b, both between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= e <= 10**9 for a, b, e in corridors)
preconditions.description: The energy requirement e for each Corridor is between 0 and 10^9 inclusive.
The number of Corridors in the input is exactly m.

preconditions.expression: len(set((a, b) for a, b, e in corridors)) == m
preconditions.description: Each pair of destinations is connected by at most one Corridor.

postconditions.description: The output E_max(c_1) is between 0 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == max(e for e in range(0, 10**9 + 1) if c1_in_mst(n, m, corridors, e))
postconditions.description: The output E_max(c_1) is the largest energy e such that if the energy of the first Corridor is set to e, it still belongs to some minimum spanning tree.
